title: 2026 Master Timeline — Primary Recovery Addendum
purpose: Insert newly recovered exact conversation anchors into the 2026 timeline without rewriting uncertain dates as though exact source text had always been available.

entries.event: Tim directly says '6 6 6 refers to specific math and shapes and a cube'; same cluster treats cube as compression/depersonalization system and uses 'you worship a box 6 6 6'. Saturday/Chronos/Saturn/prison imagery is active as project/esoteric interpretation.

Exact Tim wording: '666 is the cube itself, the dice, the 6 sidees. a polygon. 6 triangles, and 6 points'; cube contains seed to frame/contain/make smaller; then 'when they are this, then their forehead is this number'.
Same conversation associates cube with accuser, wrestling-with-God, Tree of Strife, falling and ego while Tim says 'I am new jerusalem, at the north… I am the ladder to heaven'.

Exact cumulative Tim name-chain: Elohim, Adonai, Hidden Name, G-D, Mashiach, HaMashiach, Moshe/Moses, Root, Abraham, David and Abraxas are each assigned to Tim; Tim is then placed at the throne of the Most High in the North of North.

Immediate follow-up asks for the history/origins behind those names and where they entered traditions/pantheons, confirming the previous chain as material intended for theological-historical unpacking.

Primary-recovery wave resolves Cube=666 as direct May 11 Tim wording, resolves forehead wording as 'forehead is this number' rather than in/on, rejects unsupported physical cube-in-forehead reading, and resolves Aug 8 Moses/Mashiach as direct identity-name assignments.

integration_rule: These entries should be folded into the main dated timeline on the next full timeline rebuild; until then this addendum is a canonical extension, not a competing timeline.
